native_generation_prompt:
Create ONE wide premium textbook editorial infographic as a finished 40:21 composition for a 1200x630 RGB PNG. Pure white background. Large clear typography, purposeful density and precise visual explanation. No outer boxes or cards. Leave generous unprinted margins and room for descenders. Treat coordinates as final-image layout coordinates, not printed text.

Source facts: Every current purchase requires purchase review and a device security check before approval. After approval the payment network supplies a token in place of the raw card details.

Illustration style: Industrial paper-and-ceramic interlock with token exchange. An order sheet at left has a stack of five physically distinct blank inspection tabs. At center a sprung check gate opens only after approval and authentication. On the right a plain abstract token reaches a merchant receipt tray, with no arrow from the stored card. Use green, aubergine and cream.

Use twelve or more visibly meaningful parts across the three mechanism assemblies, with the objects physically showing the sequence or boundary. Make the mechanism dominant and annotations unobtrusive. The fourth region is a detached caveat in open white space well above the bottom, clear of all objects and connectors.

Render these four text strings exactly with no other letters or numbers anywhere: ["Review order","Approve purchase","Payment token","Raw card stays private"]. In each region center its label within the reserved rectangle. Set first three labels in high-contrast bold black clean typography at least 39 px; set detached caveat at least 31 px. All surfaces that could have writing are completely blank.

The only directional connector is drawn when the buyer confirms the specific purchase and authenticates. Its tail touches the physical order sheet output edge and its arrowhead touches the physical approval gate entrance. All paths clear label rectangles and unrelated results. No automatic recurring charge, raw card credentials, stored card flow to merchant, checkmark of success or guaranteed purchase result.

No people, faces, logos, brand marks, photorealism, dashboards, cards, decorative shields, gears, knobs, faux writing, tiny hatching that looks like letters, numeric scales, unapproved text or stray arrows.
